lines.text: At a Quotidian residence in the Ark.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... So what you're saying is...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn went rogue...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: she stole Hammering's head that had been contaminated by the crystals and brought it to Sixo...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: which led to a terrorist attack in the Ark...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And now her whereabouts are unknown.
... If you don't mind, could you tell me where she might be? I think she's lying low right now.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Hold up, is she seriously okay? She looks like she's gonna blow.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'd probably react the same if you or Neon got into trouble.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Ah... right, that makes sense. Yeah, that's also tied to the terrorist attack.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: You two, if you're going to whisper, do it properly or just tell me straight.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: All right, we'll tell you directly next time.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And... what do you intend to do once you find Liveryn?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We'll ask her about Sixo's location.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: To be precise, where her core hardware is at.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And then what?
No idea... I'm not sure what they'll charge her with.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Let's go then.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I think I know where to go.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: You're still under house arrest, right? Don't worry, we'll get you out, so gear up and come with us!

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: No, we're leaving now.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I'm okay. Let's go now.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... Liveryn has worked with Sixo for a long time.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She's probably the one who's worked with Sixo the longest.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I'm not exactly sure where Sixo is, but I have a rough idea.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Looks like you've come to the right person.
Let's get a move on.
How'd Liveryn end up working with Sixo?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: It's... probably something you hear often.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: A massive number of robots got put on transportation jobs, so the Pathfinder Squad... well, we lost ours.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Ingrid tried asking around everywhere, but there wasn't anywhere to put us.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: So we just barely scraped by.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... No, life was really hard back then.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I... had a younger sister.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn, her, and I moved in together because we were broke.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn and I didn't have jobs, but my sister... she kept getting into trouble, somehow.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: It was really tough.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: That's when I decided to work in the service industry.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Then... my sister got into big trouble, and suddenly we had this huge debt to pay off.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn disappeared for a few days, then came back with a ton of money.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I guess... that's when she started working as a transporter for Sixo.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Anyway, we took care of my sister's mess, and after that, Liveryn started spending more and more time outside.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She... earned a lot.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: We moved into a new place, got some furniture, bought lots of clothes, and stocked up on food.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Back then, Liveryn was transporting illegal goods,

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: dangerous items bought on the Dark Net.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She never got caught by Enikk because she knew the Ark's routes like the back of her hand.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She was good at it, even if it was illegal.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She made a huge fortune... It felt like stepping into a whole new world.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I knew Liveryn wasn't doing exactly honest work, but I didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Because... she seemed really happy, you know.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I can never forget the way she looked when she came home with her hands full of food.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: It must have been hard for her, since it wasn't exactly normal work.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: But... I guess she put up with it because she could see how happy it made us.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: That's why I couldn't bring myself to say anything.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: We kept living like that...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Until my sister died.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Small organizations clashed over those dangerous items,

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: and she got caught up in it... and died.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn blamed herself, and I resented her.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: If those items hadn't fallen into their hands in the first place, none of this would have happened.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: It took quite a while before she finally came back.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: She completely cut ties with Sixo and got back to working with me in the service industry.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Then, out of the blue, she volunteered to join you for the surface exploration mission.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Sixo threatened to tell Ingrid about all the illegal things she'd done,

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: and that's how we ended up here.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... What will you do when you see her?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Find out where Sixo is, and then...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I don't know. I haven't really thought about it yet.
... Let's get going.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: All right, we just need to go a little further.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn's probably... at the first house we used to live in together.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: This is the slum... so there are loads of places Enikk can't keep an eye on.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I'll take you there.
Liveryn hugs her knees, staring blankly into space.
After a moment, she turns her head toward one corner of the room.
Non-perishable rations are stacked high there,
enough to last for at least two years.
A satisfied smile spreads across her face, and she nods.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I just need to stay like this.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: If I stay right here, everything will work itself out.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Then I'll go out. I'll go see Fragile and apologize to Hammering too... That should be enough.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: By then, a lot of time will have passed, so things should have settled down.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Yeah, that's how it'll be. Sixo will probably be dead by then too, right?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Then there'll be no one left to torment me. And since so much time will have passed, everyone will forgive me.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I really wish time would hurry up and pass already.
Liveryn stares blankly into space again.
The sound of footsteps reaches her ears.
She goes still, barely breathing.
After a moment, the footsteps fade into the distance.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: The soundproofing's still awful.
*Bang!*
The door bursts open.
Startled, Liveryn leaps to her feet and stumbles backward.
In the darkness beyond the doorway,
she sees a face she absolutely does not want to see.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Eeep!
Fragile lunges at Liveryn, knocking her to the ground and straddling her.
With no warning, Fragile starts throwing wild punches. Trapped beneath her, Liveryn throws up both arms to protect herself.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Again! Again! Again!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: F-Fragile...! O-ow, it hurts! It huuurts!

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Just die, Liveryn... If we die, there won't be any more pain... s‑so let's just die!
Rapi! Anis!
Rapi and Anis rush in, yanking Fragile away from Liveryn.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Ugh, her temper's no joke!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Calm down. Let's talk first.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: C-Com...mander?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: C-Coun...ters?
*Slap!*
Liveryn slaps herself across the cheek.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: It's... not a dream.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Fragile, y-you told them?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I'll see to it that you're put in the Rehabilitation Center

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: for the rest of your life! You won't ever come back out again!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: No, Fragile! I-I'm the victim.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Sixo... she made me do it, uh... I had no choice.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: What do you mean you had no other choice?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: What the hell have you been doing that she's still got you on a leash?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn! Out with it! Stop stammering and tell me the truth!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Er, uh...
You two should calm down first.
I stand before Liveryn.
We're going to catch Sixo.
You know where she is, right? Tell us.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-I don't really know... I've, um, never actually seen her...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sixo is an AI. She must have a core hardware, and we want to know where it is.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You don't have any idea at all?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Did you say AI? Sixo is an AI?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'm pretty sure she's... human.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: She's not.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-if she's an AI, then why would she do that to me...?
Liveryn, we've no time for that.
Do you have any idea where Sixo's core hardware is?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-I think... I might...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: At first... at the very beginning, there was always a place where I got the assignments.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I didn't actually meet her, but I always received them at the same spot... th-through text on the monitor...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: A-after some time... it switched to the phone...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Guess she figured making you go back and forth was too risky?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, she must've realized that too.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Then there's a pretty good chance the core hardware's at that first place.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Highly likely.
Lead the way. You remember where it is, right?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-I remember... I do, but...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: C-Commander... y-you've got, uh... a lot of power right now, don't you?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... What on earth are you saying?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Th-then if I help catch Sixo this time,

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: c-could you erase everything I did before...?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Maybe put in a good word with Ingrid and... maybe Enikk too?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-if the past could be undone... m-maybe we could go back to how things were before.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Then, maybe I could finally live a proper life...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: We can't go back.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: We can't go back, Liveryn.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Wh-why not?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: You had plenty of chances.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: But every time one came along, you picked only the choices you weren't supposed to.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: At every fork, you just went down the paths clearly marked "off-limits."

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: That's how we ended up here.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Look at the paths you've taken. They're a mess. Revolting. Like trash.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And now... you want to undo it all at once? Don't you have any shame?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And these?
*Clatterrr*
Fragile knocks over the rations piled in the corner of the room.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Did you really think hiding out here would somehow make everything work itself out?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Of course not, you're out of your mind.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Just accept your punishment, Liveryn. You have no other choice.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I don't want to be punished...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Wh-what did I do that was so wrong?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: All I've done is try to make a living. You know that, Fragile.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: For people like us to live even a halfway decent life, we had no choice but to take risks. You know that too.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: That's how we ended up in a big house, eating good food.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I really had no choice.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Liveryn...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Do you know when I was happiest?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Here, in this cramped little single room... I was happiest when the three of us lived together.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Even though the future seemed uncertain, we still had hope.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: And honestly, we were slowly getting better, little by little.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: If it weren't for that filthy money you brought, we could have kept going...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Don't give me that nonsense!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Y-you were happy too!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: You stuffed yourself with the food I bought, and wore the nice clothes I got, didn't you!?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Not once! I've never eaten the food you bought with your filthy money, or even worn a stitch of the clothes you bought!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: W-wait, what are you wearing right now? That's the one I got for you!

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: This...? You bought me this with your first paycheck, you dummy...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: We even... picked it out together.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: You don't even remember, huh?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: You keep making excuses for there being a reason and pretending to be the victim.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: But it was what you wanted. Deep down, you did it because you wanted to.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: That's the truth.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... Do as you're told and accept your punishment, Liveryn.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: N-no, I don't... want to.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: it'd be best to remove Liveryn's brain for a scan.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Once that's done, take it up to the surface and feed it to the wild animals.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: It's completely rotten, so I'm not sure if they'll even eat it.
... Liveryn,
are you scared of Sixo, or of getting punished?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: B-both...
We will, no doubt, catch Sixo.
So if you're gonna pick a side, you might as well go with the stronger team.
Sixo can't do anything for you,
but I can.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: H-how...?
If you cooperate this time, I'll ask for leniency.
I'll try to stop your exile and memory wipe, but anything beyond that is out of my hands.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: R-really...? Is that really all I can have?
Liveryn...
You've killed and hurt so many people in the Ark,
and you almost ruined Hammering and Drilley's lives.
You nearly destroyed the lives of those two kind, hardworking people just to keep yourself safe.
Those completely innocent people, who showed you nothing but kindness, almost lost everything because of you.
... Isn't it enough that you've already ruined your life and Fragile's?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: O-our lives aren't—
Yes, they are.
Look closely, there's no going back now. It'd take way more time to fix it.
Don't let yourself sink any further. If you do, there's no getting out.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: *Sob sob*

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'll... do as you say.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: B-but... you really, really have to put in a good word for me, okay?
Okay, I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: ... Don't run away this time. I mean it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I... I won't.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: Well then... I'll leave the rest up to you, Commander.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: You're not... coming?

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I'm under house arrest. And...

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: if you were to betray us again, or run away,

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: I don't think I could take it.

lines.speaker: fragile
lines.text: See you all again.
